title: Liverpool recover at Brentford as City and Villa also take Saturday wins
summary: The Premier League’s Saturday review highlights Liverpool’s 2–1 comeback at Brentford, Manchester City’s 3–2 win over Ipswich and Aston Villa’s 1–0 victory at Newcastle. The league’s own account also points to a first top-flight win for Fulham head coach Álvaro Arbeloa after Alex Iwobi’s goal beat Hull City.
